question: Should supported Control UI notification payloads be constrained to the service worker’s registered application scope, including rejecting intentional same-origin routes outside that scope?
rationale: The implementation changes the observable URL contract from origin-wide pathname matching to an application-scope boundary; source evidence for all payload producers was not available in this read-only review.

options.title: Confirm scoped payload contract
options.body: Confirm that notification producers are intended to send only application-scoped URLs, then merge with the existing scope regressions.

options.title: Preserve an explicit external route
options.body: If a supported producer needs an origin-wide route, define and document a narrow explicit escape hatch instead of silently broadening all targets.

recommendation.title: Confirm scoped payload contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that notification producers are intended to send only application-scoped URLs, then merge with the existing scope regressions.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the current scoped-routing proposal and can clarify the producer contract or incorporate a narrow compatibility test.
